name: LSB Industries El Dorado nitrogen complex
description: Operating ammonia plant with 493,000 t/yr ammonia capacity (based on 1,350 tons per day); a blue-ammonia and carbon-capture project is in development that would capture and sequester 400,000 to 500,000 t/yr of CO2 and yield 305,000 to 380,000 t/yr of low-carbon ammonia.

source.note: LSB Industries 2025 Form 10-K, ammonia capacity table, read 2026-11-17

capacities.basis: reported 2023 direct emissions (metric tons CO2e, AR4 GWP); EPA facility ID 1003993. Facility reports as El Dorado Chemical Company; subpart PP present in 2023.

source.note: EPA GHGRP 2023 data summary spreadsheets, direct point emitters, read 2026-11-17

sources.note: LSB Industries 2025 Form 10-K (ammonia capacity and project description), read 2026-11-17
LSB Industries blue-ammonia page (CO2 and low-carbon ammonia ranges), read 2026-11-17
LSB Industries El Dorado CCS page (Class VI permit status and timing), read 2026-11-17

notes: The CCS project is pre-FID with an EPA Class VI permit under review; the capture fee is expected to start at the end of 2026, and a May 2026 agreement sets a pathway to 100% ownership of the CCS project. GCCSI's November 2024 report lists the related capture project as 'Lapis Energy El Dorado' (under evaluation, 2026; 0.45 Mtpa CO2; deep saline formation), consistent with the 400,000-500,000 t/yr range recorded here.
